hints.Stonehenge: Show huge standing stones in a circle with a flat stone across the tops, and walk around them in awe.
hints.Petra: Walk through a narrow canyon between towering walls, then show a huge carved temple front appearing and gape at its columns.
hints.Angkor Wat: Show many tall towers with pointed tops in a row, trees with giant roots growing over old stone, and walk around like a tourist.
hints.Acropolis: Climb up a steep hill, then shape tall, evenly spaced columns holding up a flat roof on top, and point at the city below.
hints.Kremlin: Show a high red wall with towers around a large square, then onion domes on top of a tall church, shivering in the cold.
hints.Alhambra: Show a hilltop palace with a courtyard of slender arches, trace lacy patterns on the walls and a pool of lions in the middle.
hints.Neuschwanstein Castle: Show a fairy tale castle with many thin pointed towers on a mountaintop, then dance like a princess in front of it.
hints.Easter Island: Make a huge stone head with a long nose and heavy brow, stand stiff and silent in a line staring out to sea.
hints.Santorini: Show white cube houses with blue round domes stacked on a cliff, a sunset and the sea far below, and take a selfie.
hints.Forbidden City: Pass through huge gates and walk through many courtyards, with a bow, as if you were an emperor with a long robe.
hints.Hagia Sophia: Look up at a vast dome far overhead, show it and a tall minaret next to it, and bow your head in respect inside.
hints.Chichen Itza: Climb a steep pyramid with stairs on every side, clap at the bottom and show an echo that sounds like a bird.
hints.Taj Mahal: Show a big dome with four slim towers around it, and a long pool reflecting it, with a sigh of love.
hints.Colosseum: Walk around a huge round arena with arched walls, fight like a gladiator, and then wave your arms in the crowd.
hints.Leaning Tower of Pisa: Stand straight and then lean your whole body to one side, balancing and holding that tilt.
hints.Sydney Opera House: Make big sails with your hands side by side, rising up like shells over the water.
hints.Grand Canyon: Show a gigantic gap in the earth, peer down over the edge, and cup your hands around your ears as if listening for an echo.
hints.Machu Picchu: Climb steep stone steps high in the mountains, pet a llama next to you, and look at mist around you.
hints.Golden Gate Bridge: Draw two tall towers with huge cables hanging between them and show cars driving over, in fog.
hints.Buckingham Palace: Stand rigid as a guard in a tall furry hat, then wave like a queen from a balcony.
hints.Burj Khalifa: Go up very, very high, narrowing like a needle, and look down dizzy from the top of the world.
hints.Christ the Redeemer: Stand on a mountain top with your arms stretched wide out to the sides, looking over a city.
hints.Mount Fuji: Make a perfect cone with snow on top with both hands, then climb it at sunrise, with cherry blossoms.
hints.Venice canals: Stand in a long, thin boat, push with a pole, glide under small bridges and sway like a gondolier.
hints.Eiffel Tower: Make a tall narrow triangle with your arms above your head, then take a photo under it.
hints.Pyramids of Giza: Make a big triangle with your arms, ride a camel across the desert, and wipe your sweat.
hints.Statue of Liberty: Stand still as stone with one arm raised high holding a torch and a heavy tablet in the other.
hints.Big Ben: Stand straight and tall, circle your arms like clock hands, and swing one arm like a big bell.
hints.Great Wall of China: Stack bricks, walk a long winding line up and down hills, and gaze into the distance.
hints.Disneyland: Wear mouse ears, ride a spinning ride with your hands up, and wave at a castle.
hints.Niagara Falls: Pour both arms down like a huge waterfall, pull a rain jacket tight, and get soaked by the mist.
hints.Times Square: Look up at huge glowing screens, squint at the bright lights, and spin around in a busy crowd.
hints.Hollywood Sign: Look up at giant white letters on a hill, pose like a movie star on a red carpet, and wave at cameras.
hints.Mount Everest: Climb a steep snowy peak with an ice pick, breathe heavily, shiver, and plant a flag at the top.
hints.Sahara Desert: Trudge through deep sand, shade your eyes from a blazing sun, and ride a camel, very thirsty.
hints.Amazon Rainforest: Push through thick leaves, swat mosquitoes, swing on vines, and wipe your humid sweat.
